offline: Run locally to see the full app

hostedIdleTitle: The live app sleeps until you start it
hostedIdleDesc: The full app runs on a free host that sleeps when idle, and starting it takes about a minute. The demo below works without it.
hostedWakingDesc: This usually takes about a minute. The live app will appear here as soon as it is ready.

hostedDisabledDesc: The hosted live app is not available right now. The demo below still works.
